###Strategy

Let's use the table to think about the difference between how many comic books Nisha and Hakim each have. That will help us write an equation we can use to find how many comic books Hakim has when we know how many comic books Nisha has.

###Difference and equation

Week | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$
:- | -: | -: | -: | -:
Nisha | $10$ | $11$ | $12$ | $13$
 | $\maroonE{\downarrow-9}$ | $\maroonE{\downarrow-9}$ | $\maroonE{\downarrow-9}$ | $\maroonE{\downarrow-9}$
Hakim | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$

Hakim always has $9$ fewer comic books than Nisha, so we can write an equation to find how many comic books Hakim has in terms of how many comic books Nisha has:

$h=n-9$

Hakim | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$

Hakim wants an equation he can use to find how many comic books he will have ($h$) when Nisha has $n$ comic books.
